edits.text:
CONFIDENTIAL SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT

This Confidential Settlement Agreement (“Agreement”) is entered into by and between Plaintiff Harrow (“Plaintiff”) and Defendant Delmar (“Defendant”) (collectively, the “Parties”) to fully and finally resolve the disputes and claims between them on the terms set forth below.
edits.name: title_and_intro

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims, known and unknown, asserted or that could have been asserted in connection with the matters in dispute between them. The Parties enter into this Agreement solely for purposes of compromise and settlement and without admission of liability.
edits.name: recitals

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Within ten (10) business days after execution of this Agreement, Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the total settlement amount of USD [SETTLEMENT AMOUNT] by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff. The Parties acknowledge that payment of the settlement amount is conditioned upon Plaintiff’s execution of this Agreement and compliance with the obligations stated herein.
edits.name: payment

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of the payment described in Section 1, Plaintiff, on behalf of itself and its past, present, and future agents, affiliates, successors, assigns, and anyone claiming through it, hereby fully and forever releases and discharges Defendant and its past, present, and future parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, officers, directors, employees, agents, insurers, successors, and assigns from any and all claims, demands, liabilities, causes of action, damages, costs, and expenses of every kind, whether known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, arising out of or relating to the matters in dispute through the Effective Date.
edits.name: release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement and the existence of this Agreement shall be kept strictly confidential, except to the extent disclosure is required by law, court order, or to attorneys, accountants, tax advisors, insurers, or other persons who have a bona fide need to know and are bound to maintain confidentiality. The Parties agree not to disparage one another in connection with the settled matters.
edits.name: confidentiality

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is a compromise of disputed claims and is not an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or fault by any Party.
edits.name: no_admission

edits.text: Add standard effective-date language, mutual non-disparagement, dismissal, governing law, and authority provisions if desired.
edits.name: drafting_note

edits.text: 5. DISMISSAL. Within five (5) business days after receipt of the payment in Section 1, Plaintiff shall dismiss any pending action or proceeding concerning the released claims with prejudice, with each Party bearing its own fees and costs unless otherwise expressly stated in writing.
edits.name: dismissal

edits.text: 6. AUTHORITY; ENTIRE AGREEMENT. Each signatory represents that it has authority to execute this Agreement. This Agreement contains the entire understanding of the Parties concerning the subject matter hereof and may be amended only in a writing signed by all Parties.
edits.name: authority_entire_agreement

edits.text: 7. GOVERNING LAW; ENFORCEMENT. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of [STATE], without regard to conflict-of-law principles. The Parties consent to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in [COUNTY/STATE] for enforcement of this Agreement.
edits.name: governing_law_enforcement
